evidence_quotes: For females pooled across sites, the 95% confidence interval for controls goes up to 1136 days, and the estimate for 90th percentile survival for the rapamycin-treated mice is 1245 days.
Consistent with our previous findings, survival of both males and females was modestly enhanced in YF animals [35].
receipts.failure_reason: The excerpt does not provide numeric effect-size data for survival or lifespan; it references a companion study for survival outcomes.

evidence_quotes: Combined data from both sexes showed a 9.6% increase in median lifespan in P4‐P30 rapamycin‐treated mice compared with control mice (treated with ethanol)

Kaplan-Meyer survival curves of Bmal1−/− mice treated with water (N = 73) or Rapatar in drinking水 (N = 31). The difference between the survival curves is statistically significant according to logrank test.
The median lifespan of untreated mice is 7.8 months and median lifespan of the Rapatar-treated mice is 11.5 months, thus the treatment increased the median lifespan by 50%.
